name: Delta capture archive and artifact binding
implementation: Added tamper-evident persistence for exact decoded Delta ob_updates frames.
Each frame receives a deterministic SHA-256 hash and a sequential hash-chain value from a fixed genesis hash.
Archive identity is restricted to LIVE_CAPTURE and retains venue/environment/symbol/endpoint/capture_id.
Added replay verification that reconstructs the Phase-76 order book and compares every artifact top-of-book sample exactly.
Archive integrity and archive-to-artifact binding failures are fail-closed.
evidence_boundary: Persistence and replay verification do not create venue provenance.
No genuine Delta WebSocket capture was executed in this environment.
Fixture/replay data remains unable to become REAL evidence through this layer.
Realized private fills remain a separate economics evidence requirement.
Historical OOS certification remains blocked until genuine time-aligned venue observations and required fill evidence exist.
next: Execute the complete Delta LIVE_CAPTURE path in a network-enabled authorized environment, persist the raw frame archive and friction artifact, then independently replay and bind the capture interval/product identity into the economics certification gate.
